title: THE WELCOME PACK SHOWS ITS ITEMS
why: From the fresh-save pass of 2026-10-03: the WELCOME PACK greeted a new player with a bare list of names over an empty page. Each row now carries the item icon the stash and shop draw, so the pack reads like a gift and not a receipt.
now: The WELCOME PACK shows a picture of each item beside its name.
